summary.text: Anna Novak is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 33 since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Novak earned a B.A. in communications and public relations from the University of Mary, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a financial advisor assistant with Choice Wealth, and she co-founded Faces of North Dakota Coal.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as the House Education Committee and the House Energy and Natural Resources Committee.
